wayfinder.contract: Wayfinder-labeled issues are planning artifacts owned by the wayfinder skill. A map carries wayfinder:map; each child ticket carries exactly one wayfinder type label. They never carry a creation issue type or severity, are exempt from the defect fingerprint contract, and defect-lifecycle discovery and reuse must ignore them.

issue_reuse_contract.candidate_selection: Only an exact canonical fingerprint match can suppress issue creation; title, body, or search-term similarity without that exact match is related non-owning evidence
issue_reuse_contract.state_verification: Treat search-result state as discovery metadata only. Before reuse or creation, directly fetch every exact-fingerprint candidate from the owning repository and verify its authoritative current state; missing or failed authoritative state verification fails closed
issue_reuse_contract.open_exact_owner: Reuse only when exactly one authoritatively verified open exact-fingerprint candidate remains and it is not labeled duplicate
issue_reuse_contract.direct_scope_owner: An open issue explicitly supplied by the user or selected by the active route is the in-scope owner only after an authoritative fetch verifies its repository, open state, and defect identity and the all-state exact-fingerprint inventory establishes that no different open exact-fingerprint owner exists. If a different unique open exact-fingerprint owner exists, select that existing owner and do not mutate the supplied issue. A supplied closed issue follows closed-history handling. Maintaining and terminally closing the verified owner requires no separate user authorization
issue_reuse_contract.open_owner_maintenance: For the unique open owner, preserve existing prose, append only verified evidence absent from its body, add the canonical fingerprint marker when missing, reconcile exact labels, and continue on that issue instead of creating another
issue_reuse_contract.terminal_closure: When the accepted fix is terminally complete and durably effective in the authoritative owning system, append any missing completion evidence and close the owning issue without separate user authorization. A committed active local installation qualifies when it is the system of record; an uncommitted, inactive, or unverified fix remains open
issue_reuse_contract.closed_history: Treat closed exact-fingerprint candidates as historical evidence. For a newly observed actionable regression after resolution, create a new issue and link the closed history
issue_reuse_contract.ambiguous_or_duplicate: Multiple open exact-fingerprint candidates or a selected open candidate labeled duplicate fail closed

fingerprint_contract.unicode_domain: Inputs must be Unicode scalar-value sequences; reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code units
fingerprint_contract.failed_invariant_normalization: Unicode casefold, trim, split on Unicode whitespace, then join tokens with one ASCII space; require at least one non-whitespace token after normalization
fingerprint_contract.affected_surface_normalization: Require affected_surfaces to contain at least one normalized typed surface. For each non-empty string, trim, split on Unicode whitespace, join with one ASCII space, and require a path:, symbol:, or process: prefix with a non-empty suffix. For path: suffixes, require repository-relative POSIX form: reject absolute paths, drive-qualified paths, backslashes, empty segments, parent-traversal .. segments, and trailing separators; remove every . segment so path:./Foo.swift canonicalizes to path:Foo.swift. Preserve case and symbol:/process: suffix semantics, reject duplicates after normalization, then sort the normalized strings by ascending lexicographic Unicode scalar-value sequence
fingerprint_contract.serialization: JSON object containing exactly failed_invariant and affected_surfaces, object keys sorted by ascending lexicographic Unicode scalar-value sequence, compact separators comma and colon, non-ASCII scalar values emitted literally without Unicode escape sequences, required JSON quotation-mark, reverse-solidus, and control-character escaping only, no trailing newline included in the hashed bytes
